// Fixture for prod-smoke.sh: the shape of app/lib/firebase_options_prod.dart with FAKE keys. The script must pick the WEB key.
class DefaultFirebaseOptions {
  static FirebaseOptions get currentPlatform {
    return web;
  }

  static const FirebaseOptions web = FirebaseOptions(
    apiKey: 'FAKE-WEB-KEY',
    appId: '1:000:web:fake',
    projectId: 'fake-proj',
  );

  static const FirebaseOptions android = FirebaseOptions(
    apiKey: 'FAKE-ANDROID-KEY',
    appId: '1:000:android:fake',
    projectId: 'fake-proj',
  );

  static const FirebaseOptions ios = FirebaseOptions(
    apiKey: 'FAKE-IOS-KEY',
    appId: '1:000:ios:fake',
    projectId: 'fake-proj',
  );
}
